title: Add compute ray marcher (HG + Beer-Lambert) and composite to swapchain
purpose: Render the volumetric plasma with physically-based single scattering and STBN jitter, output to HDR target.

steps.detail: Add shaders/rt_volume_raymarch.comp implementing: STBN jitter, cone/adaptive stepping, early-out on transmittance, Beer–Lambert with preintegrated LUT, HG phase, directional light params.
Create compute pipeline and descriptors for density 3D image (sampled), LUT (sampled), STBN (sampled), HDR target (storage).
Add fullscreen composite (existing or new) to copy/tone-map HDR to swapchain; additive with bloom if enabled.
Wire optional TAA pass after raymarch and before composite; update prev matrix after TAA.

acceptance: HDR image shows volumetric glow with controllable noise and step count
No validation errors during dispatch; stable at real-time preview settings
TAA can be toggled; reprojection stable (no purple/green)
